drivers: tobacco quit within the last 5 years
total coverage above the income multiple
rationale: Only debit is tobacco cessation 1-5 years ago (nicotine negative), which also bars the preferred classes: Standard. Build, BP, lipids, A1c, family history, occupation, driving, liver and sleep apnea are all clean. Total cover $2.0M against a $1.7M income multiple; the manual refers this to judgement, so I used judgement: the excess is modest for a 40-year-old on 30-year term and does not warrant postponing. Notebook entry does not apply.
